CustomField.description: Long-form text representation of TransactionDate with the month spelled out (e.g. "August 14, 2026"). Used by the FQS email templates so the tax-record line reads formally in plain-text email regardless of the recipient's locale. Salesforce Date-typed merge fields render locale-dependent short-form dates in email, which is inconsistent for tax-facing copy.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Long-form date used by the FQS email templates. Derived from Transaction Date.
CustomField.label: Transaction Date (Long Form)
